subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When a feature draft locks, the system shall store every part of it in the repository memory, each file's exact text included.
rationale: One home for the contract, written at the lock; the plan stays outside it (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-24, brainstorm:feature-draft#D-25)
fit_criterion: Every part of each locked fixture draft, the end-to-end fixture feature included, is retrievable from the repository memory as records and as each file's exact text; zero new files appear under the document corpus's PRD, tech-design, brainstorm, and review roots for any draft-born fixture; and the memory holds no record or capture of any draft-born plan.
